figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. (A) Comparison of the organization of the chx and chx-
YINM00100 BGCs. (B) Previously proposed biosynthetic pathway of
1 and 2.8 (C) Chemical synthesis of compounds 3 and 8 from 7.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. (A) HPLC profiles of (i) Streptomyces sp. YINM00100-wild
type, (ii) Streptomyces sp. YINM00100-ΔchxI, (iii) Streptomyces
YINM00100-ΔchxJ, and (iv) Streptomyces sp. YINM00100-ΔchxG.
UV detection at 220 nm. (B) HPLC profiles of (i) standard 3 in 50
mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH 7.5), (ii) standard 8 in 50 mM Tris-HCl
buffer (pH 7.5), (iii) boiled ChxJ incubated with 3, and (iv) ChxJ
incubated with 3. UV detection at 209 nm. (C) HPLC profiles of (i)
standard 2 in 50 mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH 7.5), (ii) ChxJ and ChxI
incubated with 3, and (iii) ChxJ and boiled ChxI incubated with 3.
UV detection at 350 nm.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. In vitro enzymatic reactions of ChxG. (A) HPLC profiles of
(i) standard 8 in 50 mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH 7.5), (ii) boiled ChxG
incubated with 8, (iii) ChxG incubated with 8, and (iv) YINM00100-
3952 incubated with 8 and HR-ESI-MS of compound 9. UV detection
at 209 nm. (B) Chemical synthesis of compounds 11 and 6 from 1.
(C) HPLC profiles of (i) standard 11 in 50 mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH
7.5), (ii) ChxI, ChxJ, and ChxG incubated with 3, and (iii) ChxI,
ChxJ, and boiled ChxG incubated with 3. UV detection at 298 nm.
(D) HPLC profiles of (i) standard 6 in 50 mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH
7.5), (ii) NADPH incubated with 11 without ChxG, (iii) NADPH
incubated with 11 with ChxG, and (iv) 11 in reaction buffer without
NADPH. UV detection was at 280 nm. 11 was prone to keto-enol
tautomerism to yield 11a (Figure S39).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption: Figure 4. Newly proposed cycloheximide and actiphenol biosynthetic pathway.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. (A) Chiral HPLC profiles of the following: (i) Standard
(2S)-2-methylphenylpropionaldehyde (solid up-pointing triangle).
(2S)-2-Methylphenylpropionaldehyde was easily oxidized to produce
impurity 2-methyl-3-phenylpropanoic acid (solid circle). UV
detection at 211 nm. (ii) Standard (R/S)-2-methylphenylpropional-
dehyde (solid square/solid up-pointing triangle). (iii) ChxG
incubated with 2-methylcinnamaldehyde. (B) ChxG active site cavity
docked with 8. Three polar residues that constitute the substrate-
binding pocket are indicated.
